mechanism.minute: Kyiv Digital HTML text parser regex (?P<hm>\d{2}:\d{2}) captures minute only; datetime.strptime format %H:%M %d.%m.%y yields 0 seconds. The parser does not floor official seconds; it parses an independent minute-resolution presented source.
mechanism.precise: Official municipal JSON dateTimeStart/dateTimeEnd passed to datetime.fromisoformat without minute truncation, preserving seconds when present.
mechanism.legacy_id: db_phase1_core.legacy_episode_id SHA256(city|UTC start|UTC end)[:24], so two representations legitimately have different legacy IDs.
mechanism.evidence_strength: Source-kind differentiation verified for 184 records via four retained minute snapshots plus current precise snapshot; physical equivalence cannot be derived from temporal minute floor alone.
